metadata.name: manifest-sources-kustomize
metadata.description: Kustomize provider in the manifest-sources family. Clones a git repo and runs kustomize build in-process.

base_url.description: HTTP adapter base URL used when the integration_type declares transport=http_json.

default_path.description: Fallback kustomize overlay path inside the repo.

default_git_url.description: Fallback git_url when input omits one.

auth_mode.description: Clone auth mode. Empty/default uses the static github_token; 'github_app' mints a fresh installation token at clone time.

installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID; flat fallback when organization_installations has no entry for the repo owner.

organization_installations.description: Map of repo owner (org) -> GitHub App installation ID, so one instance can clone across orgs (e.g. dakasa-co + dakasa-yggdrasil).

api_base_url.description: GitHub API base URL for minting installation tokens (default https://api.github.com).

private_key.description: GitHub App private key (PEM); used to mint an installation token at clone time when auth_mode=github_app. Prefer a secret:// reference.

github_token.description: Optional PAT or GitHub App installation token for private repos.

private_key.description: GitHub App private key (PEM) used when auth_mode=github_app to mint a fresh installation token at clone time.

action_catalog.name: generate_installation
action_catalog.description: Render a git+kustomize source into Kubernetes objects.

action_catalog.name: reconcile_installation
action_catalog.description: Return the same rendering framed as a reconcile plan for apply.

action_catalog.name: discover_installation_state
action_catalog.description: Return planned state from the blueprint — manifest-sources are stateless.
